description: This file defines a background service and a controller activity within an Android application, handling notifications and service lifecycle.

classes.name: NotificationBackgroundService
classes.description: A background service that can be started by notifications and can cancel notifications.

classes.name: NotificationBackgroundService.Controller
classes.description: An activity providing a UI to trigger notifications related to the background service.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles service start requests, cancels a notification, and stops the service.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null, as binding is not supported for this service.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and sets up button click listener.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Builds and posts a notification with specified text.
